payload.summary: Built the gate projection: a snapshot table and service in the coordinator, four /gates routes, and a read-only collector in the supervise skill. All of it is verified by unit tests only; nothing was deployed.

decisions.title: Routes reuse the approval policy operations
decisions.rationale: Push, delete and decide are checked as request_approval on the project, listing as check_approval. The projection is a view over approval-shaped state, so no policy vocabulary was added. Chosen during implementation; not confirmed by the operator.

decisions.title: Answer hints name the skills directory the collector runs from
decisions.rationale: The installer rejects a hard-coded canonical skills path in a command string, and the path differs between the source tree and an installed copy. The collector derives it at run time and prints a placeholder when it reads a repository it is not installed in.

decisions.title: A referenced approval id is resolved in one extra read
decisions.rationale: ApprovalService.get_requests tells a decided request from an id that names nothing, so a decided gate is dropped from the listing and an unknown id falls back to the repository route.
